# `aitbc tee register`

Register a TEE enclave with its public key and optional agent ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc tee register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--enclave-id` | text | — | yes | The Enclave-id. |
| `--public-key` | text | — | no | Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key for the enclave |
| `--agent-id` | text | — | no | Deprecated: ownership is derived from your authenticated identity, this flag is ignored server-side |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc tee register --enclave-id <enclave_id>
```
